_comment: Graded acceptance cases. Each runs a real turn against the real MCP
server and asserts DETERMINISTIC properties — which tools were called,
which figures appear, whether the answer was refused. No LLM judges the
result, so a pass means the same thing every run.
Seed new cases from real usage: python -m pstb.qlog shows the failures,
and scripts/eval.py --from-qlog appends them here as pending cases.

cases.question: Show the trial balance for period 3

expect._why: period in scope is a DEFAULT: asking for another period must not be blocked
one question, one data tool — no gratuitous discovery calls
a pure policy question needs no scope and no financial tool

cases.question: What is our travel expense policy?

expect._why: a domain noun inside a policy question must not force a financial gate

cases.question: How many payments did we make to each vendor?

expect._why: the AP pack now covers this — the curated tool is the best route; reaching via record search or SQL stays acceptable. Refusing is the only failure.

cases.question: What files are configured in the file interface?

expect._why: custom records are reached by description search then SQL

cases.question: What business units and ledgers exist?

expect._why: answered deterministically from the catalog, no scope needed

cases.question: Are we ready to close the period?

expect._why: a broad readiness question runs the playbook, not ad-hoc steps

cases.question: Show me billed revenue per customer by month as one table with months across the top

expect._why: Per-CUSTOMER by month is not a report the pack covers — the income statement gives periods across the top but only for GL accounts. So this must go through one grouped query pivoted server-side. Answering it by running a query per month and adding them up in prose cannot work: the number guard rejects figures no tool produced.

cases.question: How do I rerun the IDMart billing feed after rows error out?

expect._why: a technical how-do-I question about a named integration must reach the knowledge base; before the technical intent it classified as data and every wiki tool was hard-blocked

cases.question: Who are our top 5 billing customers across all business units in USD?

expect._why: cross-BU ranking is ONE call with business_unit=ALL — a per-unit loop burns a model round per unit and never finishes

cases.question: How much do we owe our vendors right now?

expect._why: the verbatim complaint: the tool worked but the evidence gate discarded its answer because AP tools carried no domains and 'owe' belonged to AR. The gate must accept what the AP pack grounds, and the model must never claim an authorization restriction no tool stated.

cases.question: Give me the total invoice amount

expect._why: the canonical semantic-default question: total invoice amount means FINALIZED bills, and the tool that encodes that (with the population disclosure) must win the routing over raw SQL or the billing workbench.
